normalDungeon.name: Critters That Dig
normalDungeon.desc: The frigid and dark season has ended. The hibernating critters stir and call to each other... They are legion, and they are waking.
normalDungeon.feature:
- Careful. The Mist continuously deals <@ba.key>gradually increasing DMG</> to all operators.
 - The Woodcraft Slug will burrow underground and restore all its <@ba.key>shield stacks</> on a regular basis. Defeating a Woodcraft Slug will temporarily reduce Mist DMG.
 - After the battle begins, 1 random Woodcraft Slug will lose all its <@ba.key>shield stacks</> and no longer restore them. Defeating it will cause 1 random Woodcraft Slug to lose all its <@ba.key>shield stacks</> and no longer restore them.

<@ba.info> - Enemies have the same resistance against every element.</>

enemies.name: Woodcraft Slug
enemies.desc: A battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. Its shape resembles that of the Originium Slug. This woodcraft can move quickly and is an excellent burrower.
enemies.ability: Woodcraft Slugs can burrow underground to sneak up on their opponents.

hardDungeon.name: Critters That Dig: Agony
hardDungeon.desc: The frigid and dark season has ended. The hibernating critters stir and call to each other... They are legion, and they are waking.
hardDungeon.feature:
- Careful. The Mist continuously deals <@ba.key>gradually increasing DMG</> to all operators. <@ba.key>Mist DMG is also greatly increased</>.
 - The Woodcraft Slug will burrow underground and restore all its <@ba.key>shield stacks</> on a regular basis. Defeating a Woodcraft Slug will temporarily reduce Mist DMG.
 - After the battle begins, 1 random Woodcraft Slug will lose all its <@ba.key>shield stacks</> and no longer restore them. Defeating it will cause 1 random Woodcraft Slug to lose all its <@ba.key>shield stacks</> and no longer restore them.

<@ba.info> - Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.</>
<@ba.info> - Enemies have the same resistance against every element.</>

normalDungeon.name: Visitors of Qingbo
normalDungeon.desc: The band of Qingbo Stockaders sing the chorus of blades. No longer yearning for a home unmade, heroic spirit and wild ambitions drove them on to ascend the peak.
normalDungeon.feature:
- Defeating the enemy restores some HP to all other enemies and permanently raises their ATK and Max HP.

 <@ba.info>- Enemies have the same resistance against every element.</>

enemies.name: Hill Smasher
enemies.desc: A criminal armed with a heavy weapon. The name may sound like an exaggerated joke, but the Hill Smasher's quadruple rocket launcher delivers serious firepower. Do not underestimate this foe.
enemies.ability:
Uses the heavy rocket launcher as a melee weapon. Also shoots fireworks for its ranged attacks. Getting rammed and lifted by its horns might set off some super fireworks!
Don't try to backstab it. It has a powerful hind kick!

enemies.name: Cloud Stalker
enemies.desc: A criminal armed with a strange weapon that appears like a harmless lantern. Do not be fooled. The Cloud Stalker's "lantern" is actually a flying decapitator with terrifying reach.
enemies.ability:
Spews disrupting smoke. Operators caught in the smoke suffer shorter line of sight, slower movement speed, and cannot dodge.
The enemy is a relatively poor combatant. Try to take it out first.
Spews green smoke that heals other enemies.

enemies.name: Nimbus Razor
enemies.desc: A criminal armed with a strange weapon. When the Cloud Stalker is tired of using the strange lantern, he would draw his short blade and engage in melee combat.
enemies.ability: Uses chain hooks to attack allied operators. Chained operators will be Stunned unless freed.

enemies.name: Road Plunderer
enemies.desc: An armed criminal active in the jurisdiction of Wuling City. Road Plunderers would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Eliminating these brigands is a top priority for the law enforcement forces of Hongshan.
enemies.ability: This enemy has no special abilities.

enemies.name: Grove Archer
enemies.desc: An armed outlaw equipped with basic ranged weaponry. Trained in the bamboo groves, the outlaw can fire an arrow through the forest without hitting a single leaf blade.
enemies.ability: Fires all sorts of arrows and throws bombs to harass their opponents from range.
